title: Search of Marcus Vinicius's house and computer for the tape

tellings.quote: James went there. They searched his whole house, you know. They took his computer to a warehouse in S. Paulo.

plain: Italo Venturelli, a surgeon in Brazil, tells of a man named Marcus Vinicius, who is said to have had a video tape tied to a reported alien case in the town of Varginha. Venturelli says, passing on what a man named James Fox told him, that after about 2018 Fox went there, Vinicius's whole house was searched, and his computer was taken to a warehouse in São Paulo. If true, the tape may still be somewhere among his belongings.
